intent.raw: define design and plan an API for agents to consult the Anime.js ontology and add work episodes, reusing the read-only Augmentor precedent without collapsing write authority
intent.objective: Produce a non-executed, implementation-ready architecture and Work Pack for a split Anime.js consultation and append-only WorkEpisode API with source, evidence, identity, concurrency, replay, recovery, and Lesson-promotion boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: define design and plan API for agents to consult the Anime.js ontology and add work episodes

route_menu.context_hint: Consultation, evidence capture, graph mutation, and Lesson promotion have different owners and proof requirements.

items.label: Split read and append capabilities
items.description: Read an immutable neutral projection; append immutable episode events through a distinct authority boundary. Selected.

items.label: Combined read/write endpoint
items.description: Rejected because consultation credentials could acquire durable evidence-write effects.

items.label: Direct graph mutation
items.description: Rejected because WorkEpisode capture must not rewrite documentation facts or grant Lesson status.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Two independent failure surfaces must be attacked before repair: authority leakage across the read/write boundary and non-deterministic or forgeable episode state.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Two read-only critics inspect the same exact design corpus from distinct angles, join before repair, and return advisory change requests. The parent retains definition, design, repair, planning, and final approval.
context: The Anime.js vault is candidate-local, private, non-authoritative, and currently has zero verified operational lessons.
The Augmentor consultation route is a current read-only neutral-projection precedent and must not gain write effects.
WorkEpisode, Attempt, Outcome, EvidenceRecord, VersionContext, and Lesson already have non-collapse rules in the vault vocabulary.
This run is planning-only and cannot mutate the vault or the consumer runtime.

roles.purpose: Attack capability separation, principal binding, neutral projection, transport ownership, data leakage, and accidental authority inheritance.
roles.owns: One read-only design-review receipt; no source, design, runtime, graph, or final-synthesis authority.

roles.purpose: Attack idempotency, expected revision, replay, partial failure, evidence forgery, closure, supersession, reducer determinism, and accidental Lesson verification.
roles.owns: One read-only design-review receipt; no source, design, runtime, graph, or final-synthesis authority.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm the displayed ten-stage Refine route and two read-only design critics?

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the source, ownership, or write boundary is ambiguous.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Consultation remains useful without gaining durable write effects.
Episode append remains useful without directly rewriting graph truth or verifying Lessons.
Every principal, source, evidence, version, digest, and state boundary has an owner.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Block external research unless a named material gap receives separate operator confirmation.

steps.name: Initial Distill
convergence_criteria: The smallest coherent system is a read projection plus a distinct append journal and deterministic reducer.
Direct graph writes and automatic Lesson verification are excluded.
The selected unit recomposes into an agent-consultable knowledge loop.

steps.name: Governed two-critic design review
convergence_criteria: Read credentials cannot invoke durable writes.
Append commands are replay-safe, revision-bound, identity-bound, and recoverable.
Evidence and closure cannot fabricate success or a verified Lesson.
Both critic receipts are joined and closed before repair.

steps.name: Distill Repair and toy scenarios
stop_conditions: Block if a read credential can append an event.
Block if retry can duplicate an event or stale writers can silently win.
Block if closure or materialization can imply a verified Lesson.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: Block mutation-capable handoff if a SWU is task-shaped or lacks closeout synchronization.
Block if the plan performs implementation or consumer integration.

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates and every cited technique affects a step, gate, artifact, or residue item before stages begin.
The operator explicitly confirms the displayed ten-stage route and two read-only critics for this exact material strategy.
Before reviewers spawn, a schema-0.8.0 exact-material review sheet passes Inventory preflight, deterministic validation, two independent tension checks, registration, and confirmation equivalence.
Both approved critics are spawned, joined, closed, and return their exact receipts before Distill Repair.
External research may run only after a named material gap and separate bounded-research confirmation.
Consultation is read-only; WorkEpisode append is separately authorized; the append journal is canonical operational evidence; graph views are deterministic derivatives.
Episode closure, success outcome, and evidence attachment do not automatically create or verify a Lesson.
The medium/high Work Pack contains layer-mapped waves, implementation-detail task specs, atomic SWUs, validation, and complete Task Session closeout synchronization.
This run creates design and planning evidence only; source, vault, product, runtime, integration, deployment, and release mutation require later admitted routes.
RESULT.md is grounded in every stage artifact, both joined critic receipts, validation outputs, and explicit residue.

boundaries.contract: The confirmed material strategy authorizes the ten-stage planning-only Refine run and exactly two read-only design critics.
Read capability and credentials cannot invoke append commands; append requires a distinct principal grant and returns an immutable receipt.
Only validated immutable events are reduced into derived episode snapshots and graph material; documentation nodes are never directly rewritten.
No API event, episode closure, reducer, or materializer may create a verified Lesson; a later owner-reviewed route is required.
Refine authors artifacts and expected receipts only; it does not execute any SWU or mutate the product/vault/runtime.
External evidence requires a named material gap and separate operator confirmation; local owner evidence remains decisive.

authority.evidence: source owners plus future episode-evidence owner

state_namespaces.write_policy: Planning and governed review evidence only.
Append-only through separately authorized commands; absent and unimplemented in this run.

promotion_splits.rule: The agent may reason over bounded source-linked evidence without treating it as authority or durable memory.
A separate review owner must prove successful outcome, admissible executed witness, scope, and invalidation bounds before verification.

promotion_guardrails: The consultation projection is read-only, private, bounded, and non-authoritative.
The episode journal records claims and observations; it is not documentation truth or authority.
An accepted WorkEpisode is not a verified Lesson.
A passing design and Work Pack are not implementation, deployment, release, or production evidence.
No Consumer, Augmentor, Inventory, ontology, memory, or promotion owner is replaced by this design.
